plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.text.headline: The world now: war, blackouts and a cyclone (example)
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.text.summary: The biggest hotspots in the sample snapshot are Iran without internet, the attacks on Ukraine's energy grid and the civil war in Sudan, plus a red-alert cyclone in the Philippines.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.0.text: The war in Ukraine remains the most severe conflict on record; four newsrooms reported a drone attack on energy infrastructure in Kharkiv.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.1.text: In Sudan, the civil war is concentrated in North Darfur, with displacement and restricted humanitarian access.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.2.text: Iran has no internet nationwide, on government orders according to Cloudflare Radar, and protests have been suppressed.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.3.text: A red-alert cyclone has reached the Philippines, with thousands of people evacuated from the coast.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.4.text: The three countries with the most attention combine violence with the loss of basic services — power, internet, humanitarian access — which spreads the effect beyond the recorded deaths.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.points.5.text: Among the stock indices tracked, the Ibovespa had the biggest drop in the last session; the series card explains the factors behind that day.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.watch.0: How long Iran's internet shutdown lasts
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.watch.1: Whether the attacks on Ukraine's energy grid continue as the cold sets in
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.watch.2: Whether humanitarian aid reaches North Darfur again
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.counterpoint.text: A picture built from databases that record violence and from newsrooms that publish in English tends to leave out slow crises — hunger, drought, debt — that do not generate daily events.
plz:analysis:panorama-mundo-2026-10-25.limits: The overview uses only the facts in this snapshot. Regions with little press or database coverage appear less than they should.
